info.name: Kumele API — Full Collection (2026-07-24)
info.description:
Auto-generated from the live OpenAPI spec (prod /docs-json) on 2026-07-24. Grouped by module, with realistic sample request bodies inferred from DTO schemas. Public endpoints have no Authorization header; user endpoints send {{accessToken}}; Admin-* folders send {{adminToken}}.

Setup: run Auth > POST /auth/login (or /auth/signup) with real creds, copy the returned access_token into the `accessToken` collection/environment variable (or set up the included test script to do it automatically).
